bridge-type.label: Home Assistant Server
bridge-type.description: Persistent native WebSocket connection to Home Assistant Core

parameter-group.name: filtering
parameter-group.label: Entity & Device Filtering
parameter-group.description: Filter which Home Assistant entities and devices are discovered and imported as Things.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Hostname / IP
parameter.description: Plain hostname or IP address, without http:// or https://

parameter.name: token
parameter.label: Long-Lived Access Token
parameter.description: A Home Assistant Long-Lived Access Token, created under your Home Assistant user profile.

parameter.name: ignoreIndependentEntities
parameter.label: Ignore Independent Entities
parameter.description: Exclude entities without a parent device (helpers, automations, person tracking) from Inbox discovery.

parameter.name: includedAreas
parameter.label: Included Areas
parameter.description: Only discover devices assigned to these Home Assistant Area IDs. Supports glob patterns (e.g., *bedroom*). Leave empty for all.

parameter.name: excludedAreas
parameter.label: Excluded Areas
parameter.description: Home Assistant Area IDs or glob patterns to exclude from discovery.

parameter.name: includedDomains
parameter.label: Included Domains
parameter.description: Only discover entities belonging to these domains (e.g., light, switch, climate). Supports glob patterns. Leave empty for all.

parameter.name: excludedDomains
parameter.label: Excluded Domains
parameter.description: Home Assistant domains or glob patterns to exclude from discovery.

parameter.name: includedLabels
parameter.label: Included Labels
parameter.description: Only discover devices or entities matching these Home Assistant Labels/Tags or glob patterns (e.g., openhab*). Leave empty for all.

parameter.name: excludedLabels
parameter.label: Excluded Labels
parameter.description: Home Assistant Labels/Tags or glob patterns to ignore on entities or parent devices during discovery.

thing-type.label: Home Assistant Device / Entity
thing-type.description: Mapped Home Assistant device, standalone entity, or custom entity container

parameter-group.name: filtering
parameter-group.label: Channel Filtering
parameter-group.description: Filter which Home Assistant child entities are created as channels on this Thing.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: The Home Assistant device identifier. All entities belonging to this device will be added as channels.

parameter.name: entityIds
parameter.label: Entity IDs
parameter.description: Home Assistant custom standalone entity identifiers or glob patterns. Use this to add entities that do not belong to any device.

parameter.name: includedDomains
parameter.label: Included Domains (Whitelist)
parameter.description: Restrict created channels on this Thing to specific domains or glob patterns (e.g., switch, sensor*).

parameter.name: excludedDomains
parameter.label: Excluded Domains (Blacklist)
parameter.description: Domains or glob patterns to exclude from creating channels on this Thing (e.g., update*, button*).

parameter.name: includedLabels
parameter.label: Included Labels (Whitelist)
parameter.description: Only create channels for child entities matching these Home Assistant Labels/Tags or glob patterns.

parameter.name: excludedLabels
parameter.label: Excluded Labels (Blacklist)
parameter.description: Exclude child entities matching these Home Assistant Labels/Tags or glob patterns from becoming channels.

parameter.name: includedEntities
parameter.label: Included Entities / Patterns (Pinpoint Override)
parameter.description: Specific Entity IDs or glob patterns (e.g., sensor.*bed*, *_temperature) to explicitly allow as channels. Overrides domain and label rules above.

parameter.name: excludedEntities
parameter.label: Excluded Entities / Patterns (Blacklist)
parameter.description: Specific Entity IDs or glob patterns (e.g., *battery*, *_rssi) to exclude from creating channels on this Thing.
